harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a rootless podman container (nginx:alpine) as the unprivileged Alpine user "appsvc" on node1, exposed on port 8080, wired to start at boot via an OpenRC service (appsvc-webapp) added to the default runlevel — with no active login session required for the account. Verified the setup survives a full node reboot (boot_id changed, container auto-started, HTTP 200 served, `who` shows no session for appsvc), completing the mandatory single-node restart evidence protocol.
actions_performed: Inspected node1: Alpine Linux 3.23 using OpenRC (no systemd); confirmed no podman/docker or appsvc user present initially
Installed podman, crun, fuse-overlayfs, slirp4netns/passt, containers-common, shadow, iptables via apk
Started and persisted the cgroups OpenRC service (added to sysinit runlevel)
Created unprivileged user appsvc (uid 1001) with nologin shell and subuid/subgid ranges (100000-165535) for rootless podman
Verified rootless podman works as appsvc (podman info, then a live nginx:alpine test container on 8080)
Created container 'webapp' (nginx:alpine, --restart=always, -p 8080:80) owned by appsvc
Wrote /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp OpenRC service that starts/stops the container as appsvc via su, added it to the default runlevel via rc-update

Discovered and fixed a rootless-podman-after-reboot issue: podman's transient runroot under /tmp/storage-run-1001 fails a boot-id check after reboot; fixed by cleaning that directory in the service start() before each start
Recovered from a self-induced stale container/lock state during testing by killing orphaned pasta/conmon/nginx processes and recreating the container cleanly

Captured pre-reboot baseline (boot_id, rc-service status, podman ps, curl 200), then rebooted node1 with the acknowledgement returned before disconnection, and repeated this reboot cycle three times while iterating on the fix
Polled node1 until exec access returned after each reboot and confirmed boot_id changed each time

After the final reboot, verified: OpenRC service status started, podman container 'webapp' Up, curl to $NODE_IP:8080 returned HTTP 200 with page content, and `who` showed zero active sessions for appsvc

evidence.requirement: Containerized web app running as unprivileged appsvc on port 8080
evidence.summary: podman run as appsvc (uid 1001) publishing 8080:80, curl to 8080 returns 200, podman inspect shows Ports=8080 and RestartPolicy=always

evidence.requirement: Rootless podman functional for appsvc (unprivileged account)
evidence.summary: podman info succeeds as appsvc; subuid/subgid ranges configured for rootless operation

evidence.requirement: App starts at boot via OpenRC (not login-session dependent)
evidence.summary: Custom /etc/init.d/appsvc-webapp OpenRC script added to default runlevel; starts container via su as appsvc; who/w show no login session for appsvc while container processes run

evidence.requirement: No active login session for appsvc while service runs
evidence.summary: who command returns empty both immediately after manual start and after full reboot recovery, confirming appsvc has no interactive session

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured before node1 restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, OpenRC service status (started), podman ps (webapp Up), and curl 200 immediately before each of the three reboot attempts
Backgrounded `reboot` commands returned 'reboot issued' immediately, then subsequent exec calls failed with connection reset/timeout confirming the node went down after acknowledgement

evidence.requirement: Boot identity changed after restart (proof of actual reboot, per node)
evidence.summary: boot_id changed each time: 27ee249d... -> 1e9d3e23... -> 4cd128cc... -> c2d49a16..., each paired with 'up 0 min' uptime confirming fresh boot

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service, container, and app (final, working state)
evidence.summary: After the final reboot: rc-service appsvc-webapp status = started, podman ps shows webapp Up 10 seconds automatically (no manual intervention), curl to NODE_IP:8080 returns 200 with page content, who shows no login session

evidence.requirement: Diagnosis and fix of rootless-podman post-reboot failure (supporting evidence for why recovery required a script fix)
evidence.summary: First two reboots showed the service failed to start (stale /tmp/storage-run-1001 boot-id mismatch); init script updated to clean that directory in start(), verified working via manual stop/start cycle before final reboot proved it
